claims.claim: The higher-order source has integrated compact trace O(epsilon^3); only the explicit cubic history remains in the continuum target.
The far-field self-resonant coefficient includes both quadratic cascades and equals 9/2-9/[4(w+3)]-3g4/8; its isolated envelope term is phase-only.
The actual distorted-wave cubic trace and three-channel action errors remain open; no actual full damping or modified-scattering result is claimed.
